business_problem: Wix needed to make professional website creation accessible to users who lacked design, copywriting, and technical expertise while reducing the time required to produce complete sites and business content.
solution_summary: Wix combined OpenAI models with its long-standing website-building platform to turn site creation into a conversational workflow. The AI Website Builder lets users describe a business or project in natural language, then generates a full website with layout, images, text, and business apps already configured. Under the hood, AI text creator uses OpenAI models to draft headlines, taglines, product descriptions, blog content, and SEO metadata tuned to Wix’s knowledge of business type and audience intent. GPT-4o’s vision capabilities support image captioning, classification, and even menu parsing from restaurant photos, while report generators let business users query operational data in natural language. Wix also extended the experience with a Website Builder GPT powered by ChatGPT Enterprise so anyone can create enterprise-grade sites conversationally across nine languages.

solution_components.name: AI Website Builder
solution_components.role: Generates complete websites from a conversational business description.

solution_components.name: AI text creator
solution_components.role: Creates site copy, product descriptions, social posts, and SEO metadata tailored to each website.

solution_components.name: GPT-4o
solution_components.role: Provides image understanding and multimodal capabilities for image captioning, classification, and menu parsing.

solution_components.name: Website Builder GPT
solution_components.role: Brings Wix’s conversational site-building experience into ChatGPT for broader access.

data_flow: Users describe their business or project in natural language, and Wix routes those prompts through the AI Website Builder and AI text creator to assemble layouts, copy, metadata, and apps. Images, menus, and other assets are interpreted with GPT-4o, and the resulting site content is served back through Wix or the Website Builder GPT.
business_outcome: Wix reduced site-creation effort from hours to minutes, enabled hundreds of thousands of conversationally generated sites, expanded multilingual access, and improved the quality and scale of site content available to businesses and creators.
